name: Snapmaker Artisan (CNC 200 W)
description: Snapmaker Artisan with the 200 W CNC module (Marlin based firmware). The header block lets the touchscreen recognise a CNC file and show its time and size. The spindle takes its speed in rpm (M3 S, 8 000 to 18 000 rpm). No M6: a tool change stops the spindle, rises and pauses the job with M600; it resumes from the screen. Arcs are written as short segments, like the official Snapmaker post-processors.
